description: The new 9:ZERO:7 Sterna takes after its namesake, the Arctic Tern, which migrate upwards of 56,000 miles each year. The Sterna is a carbon fiber disc brake equipped gravel/cyclocross/road bike to rule them all. With room for 27.5x2.0 tires, Sterna isn't restricted to just roads, gravel, or muddy cyclocross courses, it's perfectly at home on rocky, root filled technical singletrack. Add our strategically placed BPI (Bike Packer Integration) bolts to the exceptional tire clearance that this bike has and you'll have the tool necessary for your own migration.
